verified_claims.claim: The Worker Protection (Amendment of Equality Act 2010) Act 2023 received Royal Assent on 26 October 2023.
verified_claims.notes: The Worker Protection (Amendment of Equality Act 2010) Act 2023 did receive Royal Assent on 26 October 2023.

verified_claims.claim: The Act introduces a new proactive duty on employers to take reasonable steps to prevent sexual harassment of their employees.
verified_claims.notes: The UK Worker Protection Act 2023 includes a duty for employers to take reasonable steps to prevent sexual harassment.

verified_claims.claim: The Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC) has the power to enforce the duty introduced by the Act.
verified_claims.notes: The UK Worker Protection Act 2023 grants the EHRC enforcement powers for the new duty.

verified_claims.claim: Employment tribunals can uplift compensation by up to 25% where an employer has breached the preventive duty.
verified_claims.notes: The UK Worker Protection Act 2023 allows employment tribunals to uplift compensation by up to 25% for breaches of the preventive duty.

verified_claims.claim: Employers should conduct risk assessments and update their harassment policies.
verified_claims.notes: The UK Worker Protection Act 2023 requires employers to conduct risk assessments and update harassment policies.

flagged_claims.claim: The Worker Protection (Amendment of Equality Act 2010) Act 2023 came into force on 26 October 2024.
flagged_claims.notes: The exact commencement date of the Worker Protection (Amendment of Equality Act 2010) Act 2023 is not confirmed in the available data.

flagged_claims.claim: The Worker Protection Act 2023 was passed in March 2022.
flagged_claims.notes: The Worker Protection Act 2023 could not have been passed in March 2022 as the dates do not align.

flagged_claims.claim: The Worker Protection Act 2023 requires employers to pay a mandatory fine of £50,000 for any harassment incident.
flagged_claims.notes: The Worker Protection Act 2023 does not specify a mandatory fine of £50,000 for any harassment incident; further details are needed to confirm specific penalties.

flagged_claims.claim: The Worker Protection Act 2023 was introduced by the Scottish Parliament.
flagged_claims.notes: The Worker Protection Act 2023 was introduced by the UK Parliament, not the Scottish Parliament.

flagged_claims.claim: The Worker Protection Act 2023 only applies in Scotland.
flagged_claims.notes: The Worker Protection Act 2023 is UK-wide legislation and does not apply only in Scotland.

flagged_claims.claim: Employers must file monthly harassment reports with HMRC under the Worker Protection Act 2023.
flagged_claims.notes: There is no requirement under the Worker Protection Act 2023 for employers to file monthly harassment reports with HMRC.

flagged_claims.claim: The compensation uplift under the Worker Protection Act 2023 is capped at 5%.
flagged_claims.notes: The Worker Protection Act 2023 does not specify a 5% cap on compensation uplift; further details are needed.
